title: ‘Beach’ to ‘Bitch’: Inadvertent Unsafe Transcription of Kids’ Content on YouTube

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating inappropriate content hallucination (taboo words) in ASR transcripts specifically on YouTube Kids videos, identifying kids' speech and baby talk as primary factors for severe transcription errors.
Manual inspection of hallucinated ASR errors to identify English as a Second Language (ESL) accents and speech patterns as a contributing factor to inappropriate content generation.
